title: Manus adapter bootstrap alignment
estimate: One bounded implementation and regression-validation pass; native hosted Memory admission is an upstream dependency, not an implementation estimate.
objective: Fully align the Manus adapter with current shared bootstrap, identity, secrets and native Memory contracts without inventing authority. Planning is an artifact-only subtask; downstream implementation remains the user's requested outcome. Use the existing shared owners for observational check, locked-Python preflight, independent source-revision readiness and hosted Manus no-AWS/no-operator-profile classification. Replace the historical Manus Memory stdio/HMAC carrier with a fail-closed native Memory 3.0 carrier/render/readiness interface that explicitly reports UPSTREAM_BLOCKED while the owner package/client and OAuth actor admission are unavailable. Keep ordinary coding usable memory-blind. Baseline is Quantum-L9/Cursor-Governance branch fix/manus-bootstrap-alignment at 334faa6957e0c2f67eeea4b397019f6a141a30b8, advanced by the parent before any source edit onto the unique PR chain #824 -> #825 -> #826 (feat/fail-closed-plan-pipeline). Preserve all 32 inherited paths and every existing owner contract. GAR decision and reasoning-owner receipts are docs/plans/manus_adapter_bootstrap_alignment_a15b0001.gar-decision.json; the tool-owned GAR run and plan pipeline own structural admission only, never runtime or live-auth admission.
success_criteria: V1 proves shared bootstrap --check performs no installation, secrets login/profile mutation, receipt removal/write, Git exclude/prune/ref mutation or scratch restoration; it leaves fixture filesystem snapshots unchanged and reports unsynchronized/missing optional components as exit 6 rather than READY.

V1 and V2 prove locked .venv absence, wrong pinned version or required import failure exits 1 before any policy/secrets/namespace/readiness consumer and never executes system Python for governance work; Manus install selects the locked validator interpreter after bootstrap.

V3 proves runtime_script_revision is independently resolved from the executing script owner, not copied from --governance; mismatched two-clone revisions yield NOT_READY/REVISION_MISMATCH and missing provenance remains UNKNOWN.

V4 proves explicit hosted Manus classification uses the shared surface detector, performs no AWS import/probe/seed or operator profile fallback whether the machine identity is present, absent or refused, never exposes values, and preserves authorized Cursor/operator behavior.

V5 proves canonical identity assurance is owned by the shared verifier; Manus materialization rejects legacy agent_id/status shortcuts, foreign/unknown/non-current actor or surface, inactive binding and stale/tampered projection before producing files; failed mint paths never source or reuse an existing assertion file.

V6 proves the committed Memory carrier is native authenticated Streamable HTTP, contains no fabricated issuer/client/callback/credential or stdio/HMAC/provider fallback, and renderer/readiness refuse the installed 2.6.0 package as UPSTREAM_BLOCKED without starting it or changing the lockfile. Canonical actor manus and surface manus-cloud remain registration only, not auth proof.

V7 proves lifecycle startup is bounded health-only, retrieval is explicit/on-demand and not a repository-write precondition; native-client absence or unproved OAuth actor admission is fail-closed for memory while governance remains usable. No lifecycle wrapper emulates admin distill or a local operator agent door.

V8 proves Infisical configured shape is separate from observed auth state, 401 outcomes name the failing stage without leaking request/response credentials, token expiry/invalid expiry never overstates usable lifetime, and offline fixtures cannot be described as live Universal Auth proof.

V9 and V10 prove matching docs/contracts/tests contain no active legacy memory instructions, preserve unrelated governance/Infisical MCP safety, pass scoped quality gates and contain only this plan's allowlisted changes; root protected files, inherited planning owners, upstream .github/Memory and secrets remain untouched.
